title: AAPS logfiles no longer available on user phone storage (e.g: /AAPS/logs)
symptom: AAPS logfiles are no longer located at /AAPS/logs (nor on /android/infi.nighthscout...). At least I could not find/access the logfiles on my phone from file explorer. Note that AAPS does have logfiles: when sending logfiles through e-mail (Maintenance menu) they are added to the e-mail.
cause: Log files have been moved to Android/data/... but with Android 11, you can only access to log folder from computer (access to this folder is locked by Android).
fix: To get to the log files you need to connect over USB or send e-mail. Moving log location back to /AAPS/logs is not possible because of newest Android limitations.
evidence_quote: Log files has been moved to previous location (Android/data/...) but with Android 11, you can only access to log folder from computer (access to this folder is locked by Android).
